verdict.rationale: Elasticsearch documents retrieval APIs suited to RAG. These include `semantic_text` with automatic embeddings, semantic search, and hybrid full-text plus vector search fused with RRF in one request. RAG systems are listed as a supported use case, and release notes reference OpenAI chat completion passthrough via the inference API. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end answer-generation or conversational API workflow, grounded-answer/citation guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of RAG use.
